Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide D-Street action on Monday
Markets.summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty snapped an eight-week losing streak by surging over 1% on Friday, driven by a rally in IT stocks and easing crude prices. This market rebound increased the market capitalization of BSE-listed companies by more than Rs 4 lakh crore.

Markets.title: Ashish Kacholia, Mukul Agrawal, others invest Rs 120 crore in IPO-bound Fusion CX
Markets.summary: Ace investors Ashish Kacholia and Mukul Agrawal-backed Sanshi Fund, along with Kotak Mahindra Life Insurance, acquired a 3.19% stake in Fusion CX for Rs 120 crore. The investment occurred ahead of the company's Rs 702 crore initial public offering scheduled to open on October 14.

Markets.title: 9 stocks zoom up to 37% in 3 months; MFs raise stakes in September quarter
Markets.summary: Mutual funds increased their stakes in about 44 companies during the September quarter. Despite these higher holdings, most of the associated stocks delivered negative returns over the past three months.

Markets.title: FII selloff intensifies! Foreign investors sell Indian equities worth Rs 45,000 crore in just 6 sessions. What can reverse the trend?
Markets.summary: Foreign investors sold Rs 45,125 crore of Indian equities during the first six sessions of October. This heavy selling was driven by elevated US bond yields and crude oil prices.

Markets.title: ET Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0: What do Shah Rukh Khan and SIFs have in common? Radhika Gupta explains
Markets.summary: At the ET Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0, Edelweiss Mutual Fund MD and CEO Radhika Gupta compared Specialised Investment Funds (SIFs) to Shah Rukh Khan to emphasize that investors should focus on clear portfolio goals rather than chasing new products. She advised investors to evaluate SIFs based on tax efficiency, derivatives strategies, risks, costs, and realistic return expectations.

Markets.title: NTPC invites industrial partners for 26% equity in co-generation projects
Markets.summary: NTPC Limited invited commercial and industrial businesses to invest in 26 percent equity for its co-generation projects. The state-run power company is seeking these industrial partners through Expressions of Interest.

Geo-Political.title: Saudi capital airport hit by second Houthi strike in two days
Geo-Political.summary: Yemeni Houthi rebels launched an attack targeting the airport in Saudi Arabia's capital for the second time in two days. The weekend strikes across Riyadh, which also targeted oil facilities, resulted in the deaths of 13 people.

Geo-Political.title: Ukraine strikes Yandex data centre in third attack on Russian tech giant
Geo-Political.summary: Ukraine struck a Yandex data center for the third time this week. The attack forced the Russian tech giant to suspend its operations.

Geo-Political.title: Poland detains man suspected of planning assassination of PM Tusk
Geo-Political.summary: Polish police have detained a man suspected of planning an assassination plot against Prime Minister Donald Tusk. Authorities acted after receiving credible information regarding potential attacks targeting both Tusk and his defense minister.

Geo-Political.title: Homes and bridges swept away as fresh floods hit Nepal
Geo-Political.summary: Fresh floods in Nepal have swept away homes and bridges. This disaster comes less than two months after catastrophic floods left thousands dead and missing, while the country was still trying to recover.

Geo-Political.title: Poland stabbings driven by online glorification of violence, Tusk says
Geo-Political.summary: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk stated that recent school stabbings, which left one person dead and others injured, were fueled by the online glorification of violence. His comments follow violent attacks at schools across Poland this week.

Geo-Political.title: Orangutans released back into Borneo forest after devastating fires
Geo-Political.summary: Rescuers released orangutans back into a Borneo forest after intense summer wildfires threatened their natural habitats. The apes were successfully relocated following the devastation caused by the fires.

Data & Insights.summary: A look at the key economic developments, data releases and market events that could shape the week ahead.

Data & Insights.title: Economic think tank says govt should withdraw proposed UPI charges. Here's why
Data & Insights.summary: An economic think tank has urged the Indian government to withdraw a proposed 0.3% to 0.4% fee on UPI merchant transactions exceeding ₹2,000. The organization warned that the fee would increase consumer prices, burden small businesses, and suppress demand.

Data & Insights.title: RBI may hike repo rate by 75-100 bps in current cycle as inflation persists- SBI Capital flags December hike risk
Data & Insights.summary: SBI Capital projects the RBI will raise the repo rate by 75 to 100 basis points in the current cycle due to persistent inflation. The firm notes that while gradual rate increases are most likely, a larger rate hike cannot be ruled out for December 2026.

Data & Insights.title: Reserve Bank of India takes steps to support rupee, opens dollar window for oil companies
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is directly supplying dollars to three state-run oil companies and tightening currency derivative rules to support the falling rupee. These measures aim to reduce foreign-exchange market demand and curb volatility while the currency trades near its record low.

Data & Insights.title: The week in charts: rate hikes, SIP flows, Airtel’s tariffs
Data & Insights.summary: Mint's weekly Plain Facts compilation provides data-driven insights and charts explaining the week's major news stories. The specific topics covered include rate hikes, systematic investment plan (SIP) flows, and Airtel's tariffs.

Data & Insights.title: CEA bats for a review of loan overdue rules for MSMEs
Data & Insights.summary: Chief Economic Adviser V. Anantha Nageswaran has recommended adjusting loan overdue rules to match the actual cash-flow cycles of MSMEs. He stated that policies should avoid rigid, uniform global standards in favor of approaches better suited to these businesses.

India.title: Delhi To Launch 1,300 Pink Electric Autos With Women, Transgender Drivers
India.summary: Delhi is launching 1,300 pink electric autos operated by women and transgender drivers. The initiative aims to provide safer and more convenient last-mile travel for female commuters.

India.title: Day Before INDIA Bloc March, Chief Justice Surya Kant Says No To Meeting: Sources
India.summary: Chief Justice Surya Kant refused to meet with a delegation from the INDIA political bloc ahead of their scheduled protest march. Sources report the Chief Justice stated the court lacks administrative authority to meet political delegations and must resolve matters solely through judicial hearings and verdicts.

India.title: 'Where Is Neha Bora Today?' AISA Chief A Running Motif As Delhi Protests Go Hybrid
India.summary: Despite the Jantar Mantar protest site remaining off-limits, hundreds gathered in pockets across Delhi on Sunday following mass detentions the previous day. AISA Chief Neha Bora became a prominent motif as protesters utilized a hybrid approach to demonstrate against alleged electoral fraud.

India.title: 'Father Will Take Care Of It': Kerala Teen After Killing 3 With Mini Cooper
India.summary: A Kerala teenager killed three people with a Mini Cooper after allegedly consuming alcohol at multiple bars. Following the crash, the accused stated that his father would take care of it.

India.title: Coffee With Rahul Gandhi, Metro Ride With PM Modi: Vijay's Balancing Act
India.summary: Actor-politician Vijay recently had a coffee meeting with Rahul Gandhi and took a metro ride with Prime Minister Narendra Modi. These contrasting political engagements coincide with his party's "Vijay for PM" campaign, which has caused discomfort within the Congress party regarding his national ambitions.

India.title: Manipal Entrance Test 2027: Check Application Process, Eligibility And Key Dates
India.summary: Manipal Academy of Higher Education has started accepting applications for the Manipal Entrance Test 2027. The entrance exam is for students applying to undergraduate programs, including engineering courses.

General.title: Saudi capital airport hit by second Houthi strike in two days
General.summary: Houthi attacks in Riyadh killed 13 people over the weekend. The Yemeni group also targeted two airports and oil facilities, marking the second strike on the Saudi capital's airport in two days.

General.title: PM says it is 'clear' Russia interfered with Brexit vote
General.summary: The Prime Minister stated that Russia clearly interfered in the Brexit referendum. He added that voters lacked sufficient information regarding foreign interference in UK democracy.

General.title: Wildlife park remains closed after fatal tiger attack
General.summary: Yorkshire Wildlife Park remains closed following a fatal tiger attack on Saturday. The incident occurred after a man entered the tiger enclosure.

General.title: Poland detains man suspected of planning assassination of PM Tusk
General.summary: Polish police detained a man suspected of planning an assassination against Prime Minister Donald Tusk. Authorities acted after receiving credible information regarding potential attacks targeting Tusk and his defense minister.

General.title: DUP MP says her party could help remove O'Neill as first minister over Drumcree row
General.summary: DUP MP Carla Lockhart stated that her party could help remove Michelle O'Neill as First Minister. This potential action stems from unionist anger over O'Neill's past involvement in the Garvaghy Road protests at Drumcree.

General.title: Orangutans released back into Borneo forest after devastating fires
General.summary: Rescuers returned orangutans to the Borneo forest after summer wildfires threatened their natural habitats. The apes were relocated to safety following the intense blazes.
